scope: xlang3 SDK prerequisite for native C++ xMind worker hosting
changes: Added C ABI calls for registering a runtime-owned remote object and starting an LRPC listener.
Added X::Runtime::RegisterRemoteObject and X::Runtime::LrpcListen with same-runtime object validation.
Listener startup rejects ports outside 1..65535; runtime destruction owns listener detachment.
limitations: The LRPC endpoint is transport, not application authentication; a worker still needs process-bound per-run authority.
xMind has not yet pinned this branch or implemented process-bound AgentRunner execution.
No xlang3 engine performance gate is required or claimed for this SDK/API-only change.
